contract: Materialize the actual Gray-basis words, encode their low q bond bits and last data bit into the existing bit*2^q+bond completion layout, cache the resulting labels, then read the actual input matrix at those labels. Returned denote table is exactly the input table pulled back along ConstructiveIsometryLocal.coordinates q composed with GrayBasis.equiv (q+1). No matrix-entry evaluation callback or arbitrary index equivalence is charged as constant time.
